title: The night of the storm
summary: A power cut during a storm brings a family together in an unexpected way.
paragraphs: The {{forecast}} had warned about a storm, but nobody in the Morales family took it seriously. Storms on this part of the coast usually meant a lot of wind and a little rain. By eight o'clock, however, the windows were shaking and the rain was coming down so hard that the street looked like a river.

At half past eight the lights went out. The television went silent. The fridge stopped humming. For a moment, nobody moved. Then the youngest, Lucas, said, "My tablet has forty percent {{battery}}," and his sister said, "Don't you dare use it all."

Their father found candles in a drawer, and their mother made a small fire in the old {{fireplace}}, which nobody had used for years. They put blankets on the floor and ate cold pizza, because the cooker didn't work either. Outside, the wind made strange noises, and every time there was {{lightning}}, the whole room turned white for a second.

Without screens, they didn't know what to do at first. Then their mother found a box of old board games. Half the pieces were missing, so they made up new rules. Their father told the story of the time he got lost on a school trip, which the children had never heard. Lucas laughed so much that he fell off the sofa.

The electricity came back at two in the morning. The lights came on suddenly, the fridge started humming and the television showed the weather news. Everybody looked at each other. "Should we go to bed?" said their mother. Nobody moved. They finished the game first. The next morning there were branches all over the street, and the family decided to have a "power cut night" once a month, storm or no storm.

forecast.meaning: a description of what the weather will be like

battery.meaning: the part of a device that stores electricity

fireplace.meaning: an open space in the wall of a room where you burn wood

lightning.meaning: a flash of light in the sky during a storm

questions.question: Why didn't the family take the forecast seriously?
options: Storms there usually weren't very strong.
The forecast said it would be sunny.
questions.explanation: Storms on that coast usually meant a lot of wind and a little rain.

questions.question: Why did they eat cold pizza?
options: They didn't have any other food.
The cooker didn't work without electricity.
They ordered it from a restaurant.
questions.explanation: They ate cold pizza because the cooker didn't work either.

questions.question: What did they do with the board games?
options: They couldn't play because pieces were missing.
They played the same game all night.
questions.explanation: Half the pieces were missing, so they made up new rules.

questions.question: What did the family decide the next morning?
options: To move to a different house
To have a night without electricity once a month
To never play board games again
questions.explanation: They decided to have a "power cut night" once a month.
